full_prompt_en: A square antique ink etching depicts a shallow stream winding through a wooded rural valley toward a small village. In the lower foreground, irregular rocks, grasses, and patches of earth edge the water, while fine horizontal strokes suggest its slow movement. The stream narrows into the middle distance, guiding the eye toward a pale cluster of buildings. A modest church-like tower with a pointed cap rises above lower pitched roofs near the center-left, partly softened by trees and atmospheric distance. To the right, a large group of leafy trees fills nearly half the frame. Their trunks lean gently from a low bank, and their crowns are built from many tiny clustered marks rather than solid dark masses. Smaller trees and bushes on the left balance the scene but leave an open light sky in the upper middle. Faint, looping cloud outlines drift across that sky without dense shading. The composition is detailed at the front edges and beneath the right trees, then becomes finer and paler toward the village. A boulder on the right bank and broken stones at the lower edge add tactile weight. Everything is rendered in brown-black ink on warm cream paper, with no modern color or glossy lighting. Fine crosshatching and delicate parallel strokes model the ground, foliage, masonry, and reflective water. The paper shows light age spots and a soft darkening near the border. No person dominates the scene. The image has an unhurried, observational mood, with the stream and tree canopy arranging a gentle route from near texture into quiet architectural distance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古旧墨线蚀刻画描绘浅溪穿过林木环绕的乡间山谷，流向一处小村庄。下方前景中，不规则石块、草丛与泥土斑块沿着水边排列，细水平线暗示水流缓慢移动。溪水向中景收窄，把视线引向浅色建筑群。中央偏左一座带尖顶的小教堂般塔楼升过低矮斜屋顶，被树木与远方空气略微柔化。右侧一组高大繁叶树占据近半画幅。树干从低岸轻轻倾斜，树冠由无数细小成团线点构成，而不是实心深色块。左边较小树木与灌丛平衡场景，却让中上部的浅色天空敞开。轻淡卷曲云线掠过天空，没有浓重阴影。构图在前方边缘与右侧树下细节丰富，到村庄则逐渐变细、变浅。右岸一块大石和下缘碎石增添可触重量。全图以棕黑墨线画在暖奶油色纸上，没有现代色彩或亮泽灯光。细交叉排线与精巧平行线塑造土地、枝叶、砖石和反光水面。纸张可见浅淡旧斑，边缘略微发暗。没有任何人物主导画面。图像气氛从容、富观察感，溪流与树冠安排一条从近处肌理走向安静建筑远景的温和路线。
style_prompt_en: Antique monochrome etching uses brown-black ink on warm cream paper to build quiet space from fine, varied linework. Short clustered strokes describe foliage, crosshatching deepens banks and masonry, and lighter horizontal marks suggest reflective ground or water. Foreground edges receive tactile detail while the distance is drawn with fewer, paler lines, creating atmospheric recession without broad tonal washes. An open paper sky keeps the intricate marks from feeling crowded. Irregular natural framing at the sides leads toward a modest central focal form. Slight paper spotting, aged margins, and the dry grain of ink convey a handled historical print. The style is patient and observational, valuing delicate contour, controlled density, and a gentle movement from dark near texture to pale distance.
style_prompt_zh: 古旧单色蚀刻画用暖奶油纸上的棕黑墨线，以细密且变化丰富的线工建立安静空间。短小聚集的线点描绘枝叶，交叉排线加深河岸与砖石，较浅水平笔迹暗示反光地面或水面。前景边缘细节可触，远景则用更少、更淡的线绘出，从而无需大块色洗也能形成空气递退。开放纸面天空使复杂线条不会拥堵。两侧不规则自然边框引向中部一处谦和焦点。浅淡纸斑、经年发暗的边缘与干墨颗粒传达被人翻阅过的历史版画。此风格耐心且富观察感，珍视精巧轮廓、受控密度，以及从近处深色肌理向浅色远方的温和移动。
theme_en: A quiet stream leads toward an old towered village among trees
theme_zh: 一条安静溪流穿过树林，通向带塔楼的古老村庄
name: Jacques Callot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
